theorem_title: The reduced ninth harmonic denominator has rate eighteen at double endpoints
formal_statement:
theorem ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonic_nine_double_log_den_rate :
    Tendsto (fun M : ℕ => logDen (harmonicPower 9 (2 * M)) / (M : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds 18):= by sorry
natural_language_statement: For the actual rational ninth-order harmonic sum at the double endpoint, $\log\operatorname{den}(H_{2M}^{(9)})/M\to18$ as $M\to\infty$ through natural numbers. There are no hypotheses; the factor eighteen is nine times the exact endpoint scaling factor two. This supplies the harmonic denominator baseline in the right-shifted Mellin construction.
